info.name: Sellora API
info.description:
Sellora backend API collection.

## Setup
1. Set the `baseUrl` variable to your server (default: `http://localhost:8000`).
2. Complete Google SSO by opening `GET {{baseUrl}}/api/v1/auth/google/?next=web` in a browser — you can't do the redirect flow in Postman directly.
3. Copy the `access` and `refresh` tokens from the redirect callback URL and paste them into the `accessToken` and `refreshToken` collection variables.
4. All authenticated requests will pick up the Bearer token automatically.

## Auth flow reminder
- Open `{{baseUrl}}/api/v1/auth/google/?next=web` in a browser
- Log in with Google
- You land on `{FRONTEND_WEB_URL}/auth/callback?access=TOKEN&refresh=TOKEN`
- Copy those tokens into the collection variables below

variable.description: Backend base URL. Change to your production URL when needed.
JWT access token. Paste here after completing Google SSO in a browser.
JWT refresh token. Used by the token refresh request.
UUID of the business you are working with. Set after creating or listing businesses.
UUID of an order. Set automatically by the Create Order test script.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Google OAuth initiation, token management, and user profile.

query.description: Origin: 'web' redirects to FRONTEND_WEB_URL after login

request.description:
Opens the Google sign-in page.

Postman will follow the redirect to Google — you cannot complete login inside Postman. Open this URL in a real browser instead.

After login, Google redirects to /api/v1/auth/google/callback/ which then redirects you to:
  {FRONTEND_WEB_URL}/auth/callback?access=TOKEN&refresh=TOKEN

Copy those tokens into the `accessToken` and `refreshToken` collection variables.

query.description: Origin: 'app' redirects to APP_DEEP_LINK_SCHEME://auth/callback after login

request.description:
Same as the web flow but after login the backend redirects to the mobile deep link:
  sellora://auth/callback?access=TOKEN&refresh=TOKEN

Open in a browser on a device that has the app installed to test the deep link.

query.description: One-time authorization code from Google. You cannot generate this manually.
Passed through from the initiation step. 'web' or 'app'.

request.description:
This endpoint is called automatically by Google after the user signs in. You never call it manually.

Included here for documentation purposes only — to show what Google sends back and what parameters it carries.

Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user.

Requires: Bearer token in Authorization header (set via collection variable).

Response:
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "email": "user@gmail.com",
    "name": "John Doe",
    "avatar": "https://...",
    "is_staff": false,
    "created_at": "2026-09-12T..."
  }
}

exec: console.log('Access token refreshed and saved to collection variable.');

request.description:
Exchange a refresh token for a new access token.

No Authorization header needed — uses the refresh token in the body.

The test script automatically saves the new access token to the `accessToken` collection variable.

Note: with ROTATE_REFRESH_TOKENS=True, a new refresh token is also returned. Update `refreshToken` manually if you want to keep it current.

Blacklists the refresh token so it can no longer be used.

The access token will remain valid until it naturally expires (60 minutes by default). For immediate invalidation, reduce ACCESS_TOKEN_LIFETIME_MINUTES in your .env.

Response: 204 No Content

request.description:
Creates a product. slug is auto-generated from name if not provided.
category_id: UUID of an existing category in this business, or null.

Partial update — only send the fields you want to change.
DELETE soft-archives the product (status=archived, is_available=false).

slug is auto-generated from name if not provided.
Deleting a category sets product.category to null — products are NOT deleted.

quantity_delta: positive to add stock, negative to remove.
Raises 400 if adjustment would result in negative stock.

query.description: Search by order number, customer name or phone

request.description:
Creates an order from the dashboard. Customer is auto-created/upserted by phone number.
Test script saves orderId to collection variables.
State machine: new→confirmed→processing→ready→completed. Any non-terminal state can go to cancelled.

item.name: Storefront (Public)
item.description:
Public storefront API. No authentication required.
All routes keyed by business slug.
Only published storefronts (is_published=true) are accessible — others return 404.

request.description:
Returns full business profile: name, theme, hero, contact, social links, storefront settings.
Used by the frontend to initialise the storefront context on page load.
Returns active + available products only. costPrice is never included.
Returns active categories only for storefront filtering sidebar.

Place a storefront order. Channel is automatically set to 'online'.

On success:
- Order created (status=new)
- Stock decremented atomically
- Customer auto-created/upserted by phone
- Owner notified by email (if enabled)

Delivery fee: KSh 300 (free above KSh 10,000 subtotal)
